audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and early state the wrong reason kegs beat the blind: "Powder Kegs detonate on his own auto — Blind Shot cannot cancel the explosion" and "Powder Kegs ignore your Blinding Shot entirely — the barrel explodes on an auto you cannot blind".
audit.why: A blind makes basic attacks miss, so a blinded Gangplank cannot detonate a keg with an auto. The reason kegs still go off is Parrrley — kegs can be destroyed by Gangplank including with Parrrley, and Parrrley is a targeted ability that the blind does not touch. Same mechanic settles the passive: Trial by Fire cannot be applied with Parrrley nor Powder Keg, so it is a melee basic attack only and your blind does cancel it. The current text tells the player his blind is worthless against the keg pattern; the truth is that it removes two of the three things Gangplank wants to do and leaves exactly one — Parrrley.
audit.corrected: Blind kills his autos, his Trial by Fire proc and auto-detonation. Parrrley is the one detonator that works through a blind, and at a flat 4.5s it always will — so treat Parrrley as the thing you cannot stop, not the keg.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank — Powder Keg: 'Kegs can be attacked by enemies or Gangplank (including his Parrrley)'; Trial by Fire: 'cannot be applied with Parrrley nor Powder Keg'

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] says Gangplank can "Remove your slows and poisons with Remove Scurvy (W) mid-trade", which also contradicts the entry's own late text saying the DoT "cannot be Oranges'd away".
audit.why: Remove Scurvy cleanses crowd control only and does not remove other debuffs. Your Noxious Trap slow is crowd control and is cleansed; Toxic Shot poison and Liandry's burn are damage-over-time, not crowd control, and are not. The two layers of this entry currently say opposite things about the same ability.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy strips the mushroom slow and heals him; the poison and the Liandry's burn stay on him. Plan the disengage around losing the slow, not around losing the damage.
sources: champ-data/_kits/gangplank.json (W Remove Scurvy: 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health')
wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank — 'Remove Scurvy does not remove debuffs other than crowd control'

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it outright: "NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere — needs concrete 'wait for X before you Y' lines". Neither layer contains a single cooldown number.
audit.why: This matchup has three cooldowns that dictate every decision and all three are knowable: Powder Keg recharges every 17/16/15/14/13 seconds, Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14, Parrrley is a flat 4.5. That produces one concrete rule — wait for Remove Scurvy to be spent before committing anything longer than a poke, trade against keg recharge, and never plan around Parrrley being down, because at 4.5 seconds it never is.
audit.corrected: Wait for Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1) before you commit a full rotation. Trade on keg recharge (17s at rank 1). Never wait for Parrrley — flat 4.5s, always up.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] says "Q maxed drops its cooldown enough that you can trade on the barrel cooldown and re-blind before he resets"; mid says "Once Q is maxed at levels 4-5... Blind Shot now has a short enough cooldown"; spikes[1].text says "With Q maxed".
audit.why: Two errors in one claim. Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, so ranking it never shortens anything — the entire premise is false. And Q is not maxed at levels 4-5 anyway; it is rank 2-3 and maxes at level 9. What actually improves at that stage is on his side: keg recharge only falls from 17s to about 14-15s while your blind stays constant, so the ratio moves in your favour without you doing anything.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank. The Levels 4-5 shift is that his keg recharge is still 14-15 seconds against your unchanging 7 — you get two blinds per barrel.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (Q cooldown '7' — single value, flat across ranks)

edits.before: Gangplank beats you in a straight level-1 poke war because Powder Kegs ignore your Blinding Shot entirely — the barrel explodes on an auto you cannot blind, and the chain hits before you can W away. Do not stand in barrel triangle formations; auto-attack his kegs the instant they appear to deny both the poke and the bonus gold. At level 2 he can still chain a keg off a bounced Parrrley (Q) before your Blind Shot comes off cooldown, so respect the all-in threat — last-hit at max auto range and let the poke be small rather than forcing a trade he can barrel through.
edits.after: Blind him and his autos miss everything, including his own kegs — Trial by Fire and auto-detonation both die to a Blinding Dart. What survives the blind is Parrrley, a flat 4.5-second point-and-click that pops kegs anyway, so he still wins a straight level-1 poke war. Do not stand in barrel triangle formations; auto his kegs the instant they appear to deny both the poke and the plunder gold. A keg recharges every 17 seconds at rank 1, so every barrel you destroy is a real hole in his pattern — last-hit at max auto range until one opens.

edits.before: Once Q is maxed at levels 4-5 this starts to tilt your way. Blind Shot now has a short enough cooldown that you can force a trade, walk out on Move Quick, and re-engage on the same Blind cooldown before he rebuilds a barrel chain. Place mushrooms on his Powder Keg spawn angles — if he cannot safely drop barrels in the pixel bush or tribush, his poke pattern collapses into short auto trades where your E poison wins every exchange. At level 6 your Noxious Trap net seals the map: plant shrooms on both river entrances and his escape paths before you force anything, so his global R is the only tool he has to influence a fight he cannot walk to.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt your way, but not because Q got shorter — Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank. What changes is keg recharge falling only to 14-15s while your blind stays constant, so you can force a trade, walk out on Move Quick, and be back before he rebuilds a chain. Wait for Remove Scurvy before you commit anything longer than a poke: it is 22 seconds at rank 1 and it cleanses your mushroom slow. Place mushrooms on his Powder Keg spawn angles — deny him the pixel bush and tribush and his poke pattern collapses into short auto trades your E poison wins. At 6, seal both river entrances before you force.

edits.before: Liandry's Angueur is the matchup-deciding item. Gangplank cannot Oranges (W) his way out of a DoT that reapplies on every auto and every mushroom trigger — if he steps into a shroom grid while fighting you, the burn stacks faster than his healing can clear it. From here you own the side lane as long as your shroom vision prevents him from flanking with barrel chains through unwarded brushes. Respect his late scaling hard: once he hits Tri-Force plus a crit item, a single Cannon Barrage at the right moment can end a Baron or dragon fight you thought was won. Stay grouped for objectives after you bank the lane lead, and keep mushrooms on every river path so you see him before he sees you.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment is the matchup-deciding item. Gangplank cannot Oranges (W) his way out of a DoT that reapplies on every auto and every mushroom trigger — Remove Scurvy cures crowd control, not damage over time, so it strips your shroom slow and leaves the burn. From here you own the side lane as long as your shroom vision prevents him from flanking with barrel chains through unwarded brushes. notes: I used one web lookup here (League Wiki, Gangplank) because the keg-detonation rule, the Trial by Fire restriction and the keg recharge timer are not in Riot's Data Dragon text and they decide the whole matchup.
